recipes.name: Potato Pesto Salad
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C)*.
Transfer the potatoes to the baking tray and toss them with the beans, oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, or until the potatoes are fully cooked through.
Meanwhile, add the walnuts and pine nuts to a small pan over medium-high heat. Toast for 3 to 5 minutes, stirring continuously. Transfer to a food processor.
Add the remaining pesto ingredients, except for the lemon zest, to the food processor as well.
Pulse until finely chopped. Set aside.
Add all the prepared veggies to a large bowl.
When the potatoes and beans are done baking, let them cool off slightly, then add them to the bowl, along with the pesto and lemon zest to taste. Toss together, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Also known as lima beans. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage The salad is best enjoyed freshly made as the arugula starts to wilt when combined with the pesto. If making ahead, store the pesto in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
